description:
SUMMARY
Beautifully presented CHAIN FREE two-bedroom home in a quiet Falmer village setting, offering solid wood floors with underfloor heating, a separate dining area, conservatory, ground floor cloakroom and a low-maintenance rear garden. Includes a dedicated off-street parking space.

DESCRIPTION
Nestled in the sought-after village of Falmer, Brighton, this CHARMING two bedroom home offers well-balanced accommodation, a beautifully established rear garden, and the benefit of a share of the freehold 
This home comprises a welcoming entrance hall with convenient cloakroom/WC, leading through to a bright & spacious front-facing living room featuring wooden flooring with underfloor heating. 
To the rear, the kitchen and separate dining area provide an ideal layout for everyday living and entertaining. The dining room flows seamlessly into the conservatory, which enjoys lovely views over the garden and offers an additional reception space filled with natural light.

Upstairs, the property offers two good sized bedrooms, including a generous main bedroom, alongside a well-appointed bathroom.

 
A standout feature of the home is the delightful rear garden, thoughtfully landscaped to create a tranquil and private outdoor retreat. The space incorporates a paved patio seating area, surrounded by mature shrubs, potted plants and well-stocked borders, with a further lawned section and leafy backdrop. The front garden is communal and maintained by the freehold organisation, ensuring zero maintenance for residents. The property also benefits from its own dedicated off-street parking space.

Falmer is IDEALLY SITUATED for excellent access to both BRIGHTON CITY CENTRE AND LEWES, with quick and easy bus and rail links in both directions. The South Downs National Park is close by
